overview.about: The Rugby League World Cup is the pinnacle of international rugby league - the 13-a-side code strongest in Australia, England, New Zealand and the Pacific. Australia have dominated it like almost no team in any sport, winning the vast majority of tournaments held since 1954. This page covers the championship-deciding final.
overview.nextEvent: The final of the next Rugby League World Cup is scheduled for 15 November. The knockout stages build to a single championship match between the two best sides of the tournament, decided over 80 minutes.
